# Third-party source assets

`RobotExpressive.glb` is the character of the Atrium world. Model by Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius), released under CC0 1.0, with facial morph targets added by Don McCurdy. Taken unchanged from the three.js repository at tag r186 (`examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive/`). `npm run assets` optimizes it into `public/models/atrium/robot.glb`.
